concerns.text: FR-008 specifies a sensitivity analysis sweeping the cluster count K over the set {50, 100, 200}, but the Assumptions section later states “A sensitivity analysis will sweep K ∈ {, low, high}” (missing values) and also mentions “unless the idea specifies otherwise”. These contradictory definitions of the K sweep range create ambiguity about the required experimental protocol.

The Assumptions paragraph contains an incomplete set notation “K ∈ {, low, high}” and conflicts with FR-008’s explicit set {50, 100, 200}. This inconsistency must be resolved to a single, unambiguous definition of the K values to be evaluated.
